description: Objects of this type hold messages attached to queues (QU_message_list).
It is also used for ja_task specific messages (JAT_message_list), e.g. job error messages

attributes.name: type
description: QI states defined in libs/sgeobj/sge_qinstance_state.h, e.g. QI_ERROR, QI_AMBIGUOUS, ...
Seems to be always 1 for ja_task messages.
